Se você se identifica com a posição, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Na Objective e Eleflow , ajudamos empresas a evoluírem na maturidade do uso de dados , implementando plataformas de dados escaláveis e soluções analíticas avançadas . Nossa abordagem combina tecnologia, estratégia e governança para transformar dados em vantagem competitiva, suportando projetos de inteligência artificial e aprendizado de máquina (ML/AI) .

Atuamos no desenvolvimento de Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, arquiteturas de dados modernas e plataformas analíticas , utilizando tecnologias como Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Microsoft Fabric e outras soluções em cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP). Agora, buscamos um(a) Tech Sales/Pré-Vendas para integrar nosso time comercial e atuar diretamente na conexão entre as necessidades de negócios dos clientes e as soluções de dados e inteligência analítica que oferecemos .

  • Entender os desafios de dados e IA dos clientes e conectar com nossas soluções, explorando oportunidades comerciais;

  • Mapear cenários técnicos e arquitetônicos dos clientes, recomendando estratégias de modernização de dados e suporte a iniciativas de inteligência artificial e machine learning;
  • Atuar como especialista em maturidade analítica, apresentando modelos de evolução e boas práticas para estruturar dados de forma eficiente e escalável;
  • Participar de reuniões estratégicas com clientes, demonstrando nossa capacidade técnica e expertise no mercado;
  • Interagir com especialistas e arquitetos de dados para garantir alinhamento entre as soluções propostas e a realidade técnica do cliente;
  • Contribuir para a evolução das ofertas da empresa, acompanhando tendências em dados, IA e estratégias analíticas.

O QUE É NECESSÁRIO PARA A POSIÇÃO?
  • Experiência com pré-vendas de soluções de dados, analytics e inteligência artificial;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de dados moderna, cloud e plataformas analíticas;
  • Vivência com Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, orquestração de pipelines de dados e soluções como Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Azure Synapse ou Microsoft Fabric;
  • Familiaridade com modelos de maturidade analítica e frameworks de governança de dados;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas e processos comerciais complexos;
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento com stakeholders de diferentes níveis.

O QUE SERIA UM DIFERENCIAL?
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de dados, modelagem analítica e governança;
  • Experiência em estratégias de dados para IA, machine learning e plataformas de dados para inteligência artificial;
  • Experiência com BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Looker, Tableau ou similares);
  • Certificações em cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP) ou plataformas de dados como Databricks, Snowflake e Fabric;
  • Certificações ou experiência em modelos de maturidade de dados e governança (ex.: DCAM, DAMA-DMBOK, MIT CDO Framework, etc.).

description:

Senior Software Engineer - packaging - optimize Ubuntu Server

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Software Engineer - packaging - optimize Ubuntu Server role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
Canonical's Ubuntu Engineering Server Team is looking for open source enthusiasts to help build the distro of the future. The Server Team maintains and packages a wide variety of software including webservers, databases, and virtualization and containerization stacks. This is an exciting opportunity for you, a software engineer passionate about open source software. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company and help us to bring free software to the widest audience.
Ubuntu Server is a platform that enables amazing technology the whole world over, and is the #1 operating system in the public clouds. Applicants to this role will have the opportunity to help with everything that goes into evolving Ubuntu. You will get to work with our experienced team and have the benefits of learning and growing alongside the best engineers in the business.
The role entails

  • Collaborating proactively within a distributed team
  • Fostering a software ecosystem with seamless user experience for all Ubuntu users
  • Evaluating contributions of other engineers to maintain high-quality software standards.
  • Playing a role in shaping the future of Ubuntu via both - new ideas in your areas of interest and advising on work being done elsewhere
  • Collaborating with other teams in the Ubuntu and Debian communities, with upstream projects, and commercially supported customers
  • Owning the maintenance of Ubuntu Server packages. Specifically but not limited to:
    • Traditional server workloads (web servers, databases, network services, etc)
    • Virtualisation and Containers
    • Package management and dependencies
    • Language runtimes and toolchains
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • Interest or experience in open source maintenance or contributions
  • Able to replay complex workloads and systems. Able to write detailed test plans and reproducibility steps.
  • Feel comfortable contributing and debugging many languages such as C/C++, Python, Rust, Go, Ruby, PHP
  • Experience in packaging in one or more ecosystems. This could be language specific systems (Python wheels, Rust Crates, Go Modules, or other equivalent) or any distro package format (deb, rpm, NixOS, or other equivalent).
  • Experience using and creating containers and virtual machines
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree (or any higher) or equivalent professional experience (5+ years of professional experience)
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Nossos 2.500 funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office, e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

No nosso BRQ WAY, temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor, que sabe que é protagonista do seu sucesso! Pessoas motivadas por desafios, evolução constante e apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Experiência com .Net Core, C#; Restful APIs; Programação assíncrona; Conhecimento em barramentos de mensageria (RabbitMQ, SQS, etc.); Experiência com AC2, Lambda, Load Balancer, SNS, DynamoDB, Docker, Design Patterns; Conhecimentos em SQL e Datadog.

Empreendedorismo: Possibilidade de evoluir de funcionário para sócio, com o Innovation Hub e a Corporate Venture, que investem em ideias de profissionais alinhados ao nosso negócio.

Clima descontraído, programas e eventos internos, muitas comemorações! Veja mais no nosso YouTube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminum packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe!

Ball is thrilled to receive Newsweek's 2023 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplace award! As a sustainable product leader, we have over 16,000 global team members. From endlessly recyclable aluminum cans, and cups, to aerosol bottles, our goal is to contribute to a better community, society, and world.

Position Overview:
Optimize global logistics network efficiency and effectiveness through capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse engineering. This role analyzes infrastructure, mid- and long-term supply plans, and designs agile, cost-effective networks to accommodate growth while maximizing service levels.

Your Key Responsibilities Include:

  1. Conduct detailed analysis of current logistics capacity, including warehouse space, transportation routes, and distribution centers, to identify optimization opportunities. Project mid- and long-term capacity requirements. Monitor KPIs related to logistics capacity and network performance.
  2. Utilize advanced modeling techniques and simulation tools to translate supply plans into optimal logistics networks, considering transportation costs, lead times, inventory levels, and service requirements. Provide short-term analysis and recommendations for resilient network adaptations in response to unplanned capacity or demand changes.
  3. Design and oversee warehouse layout plans to maximize productivity and throughput volumes.
  4. Establish and maintain global MHE (Material Handling Equipment), including automation standards and requirements.
  5. Collaborate with cross-functional teams—commercial, operations, planning, logistics, and finance—to align capacity planning efforts with business objectives.
  6. Lead projects and coordinate stakeholder resources for capacity expansion initiatives, such as warehouse expansions, fleet upgrades, or network reconfigurations.
  7. Regularly review and audit logistics capacity and network performance to ensure alignment with business needs.
  8. Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in logistics capacity planning, network modeling, and warehouse design.
  9. Provide guidance and support to logistics team members on capacity planning tools, processes, and methodologies.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Supply Chain Management, Statistics, or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent or advanced proficiency in English.
  • Logistics Experience:
    • Experience in logistics operations, including transportation, warehousing, and distribution, with a focus on network optimization strategies.
    • Experience designing and optimizing logistics networks, considering costs, lead times, and service levels.
  • Capacity Planning:
    • Experience in demand forecasting and resource optimization within logistics.
    • Ability to analyze logistics capacity data and identify areas for improvement.
    • Proficiency with modeling and simulation tools for demand forecasting and capacity evaluation.
  • Network Modeling:
    • Experience in designing agile, cost-effective logistics networks using various modeling tools and techniques.
  • Team Collaboration and Interpersonal Skills:
    • Ability to effectively collaborate across departments to align capacity planning with business goals.

Overview

Job Description

  • Good at communicating complex ideas and reaching out to different points of view.

  • A service-oriented mindset.

title: Gerente de Vendas | Bombas e Rodovias
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil? Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração.

Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias. Em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister, formando o maior líder mundial na área de equipamentos para concreto.

Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países. No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany começou em 2007, inicialmente como importador de equipamentos. Em 2011, consolidou sua presença no país com investimentos de aproximadamente US$ 200 milhões. Nesse mesmo ano, inaugurou sua primeira unidade fabril em São José dos Campos, SP, com 30 mil m², para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão, no regime CKD (Completely Knock-Down). Em 2012, recebeu a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008 pela Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini, garantindo rigorosos processos de qualidade e segurança.

Em 2013, iniciou a montagem de guindastes RT (rough terrain) e rolos compactadores em sua unidade de fabricação. No final de 2017, inaugurou instalações em Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias para oferecer produtos e serviços de pós-venda em todo o Brasil.

Como nosso Gerente de Vendas, você irá:

  • Desenvolver e implementar o plano estratégico de vendas para o portfólio de Bombas e Rodovias;
  • Gerenciar o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento de contratos, garantindo a satisfação do cliente;
  • Identificar oportunidades de mercado e novas demandas, analisando concorrência, tendências e potencial de clientes;
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos com stakeholders do setor;
  • Realizar visitas técnicas e comerciais, apresentações de produtos e negociações;
  • Colaborar com as áreas de engenharia, pós-vendas e operações para garantir soluções técnicas adequadas e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da área comercial (KPIs), como volume de vendas, margem, rentabilidade e forecast;
  • Participar de feiras, eventos e fóruns do setor portuário e logístico para promover a marca e gerar novos negócios.

Requisitos para se candidatar:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas técnicas, preferencialmente no setor de Bombas e Rodovias;
  • Atuação prévia com negociações complexas (grandes contas, projetos sob medida, contratos de longo prazo);
  • Vivência no relacionamento com clientes B2B e na gestão de ciclo de vendas consultivo;
  • Conhecimento de equipamentos como RTGs, STSs, guindastes móveis, empilhadeiras industriais, entre outros;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM e pacote Office.

  4. Apoio ao Setor de Vendas e Atendimento ao Cliente: Dar suporte à equipe de vendas na localização e fornecimento de peças para atender a pedidos especiais. Auxiliar no planejamento de reabastecimento e reposição de estoque com base nas necessidades e demandas. Colaborar com o supervisor para identificar itens que precisam ser reordenados. Processar devoluções de peças e realizar o controle de peças retornadas. Atualizar o estoque e os registros após o recebimento de devoluções.

  • Formação no Ensino Médio completo ou cursando Superior em Administração, Gestão Comercial ou áreas relacionadas;

Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES

Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

description:
Especialista de Proteção de Dados Sênior

Join to apply for the Especialista de Proteção de Dados Sênior role at Cielo

Job Description

Somos mais que uma máquina, somos pessoas que transformam e criam infinitas possibilidades .

Trabalhamos para simplificar e impulsionar negócios para todas as pessoas , oferecendo soluções financeiras inteligentes. Aqui, investimos em tecnologia , promovemos desenvolvimento e fomentamos a inovação para criar novos caminhos possíveis e gerar impacto positivo no mundo.

Na Cielo, a gente trabalha com autonomia para escrever nossa própria jornada, liberdade para ser quem a gente é, e a oportunidade de fazer acontecer . Somos um time que sonha no plural , oferecendo uma experiência completa e focando no bem-estar físico e mental de nossos mais de 6.000 colaboradores e suas famílias.

Acreditamos na inclusão e acolhimento de todas as pessoas, com suas singularidades e diversidade de vivências.

Bora realizar seus sonhos com a gente!

Conheça mais sobre a função de Especialista de Proteção de Dados Sênior :

Você irá atuar como Especialista de Proteção de Dados Sênior, com a missão de assegurar que informações confidenciais sejam mapeadas, classificadas, protegidas e governadas de acordo com as regulamentações vigentes, políticas e normas internas e melhores práticas, garantindo a segurança e privacidade e minimizando riscos de violações ou sanções.

Juntos com você, em infinitas possibilidades.

#VemPraCima #VemPraCielo

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estabelecer e manter um inventário corporativo de dados, possibilitando definir controles para proteção dos dados com base na sensibilidade das informações.
  • Definição tática e consultiva em práticas de segurança e privacidade em todo o ciclo de vida do dado (coleta, uso, armazenamento, compartilhamento e expurgo).
  • Evoluir e aprimorar a cobertura e efetividade dos controles de proteção de dados durante o uso, trânsito e repouso, objetivando mitigar riscos de violações de dados.
  • Mapear e mitigar riscos relacionados a dados, implementando estratégias para garantir a conformidade legal e regulatória e a proteção contínua das informações.
  • Auxiliar as equipes técnicas em investigações e respostas a incidentes de segurança, em conformidade com leis e regulações e políticas e normas internas.
  • Estabelecer métricas estratégicas de desempenho, cobertura de riscos e conformidade regulatória, fornecendo insights sobre a efetividade dos controles.
  • Apoiar a equipe de conscientização no desenvolvimento de programas internos de treinamento focado nas melhores práticas de privacidade e proteção de dados.
  • Ser referência técnica da área em assuntos sobre privacidade e proteção de dados, provendo liderança técnica com o time e auxiliando profissionais mais juniores.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que o #TimeCielo espera de você?

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação e Processamento de Dados.
  • Sólida experiência em programas de governança de dados, contemplando toda a gestão dos dados durante seu ciclo de vida, desde a coleta e uso até o descarte.
  • Experiência em processos de descoberta (data discovery), mapeamento e classificação de informações, em conjunto com as áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver e implementar estratégias de proteção de dados alinhadas com as equipes técnicas, incluindo a definição e escopo de cobertura.
  • Experiência em tecnologias de postura de segurança de dados (DSPM) com foco na análise de vulnerabilidades e ameaças e riscos de não conformidade regulatória.
  • Experiência na elaboração e análise de métricas e indicadores de risco e desempenho, assegurando visibilidade e conformidade com leis e regulações.
  • Experiência com legislação de proteção de dados (LGPD) e frameworks de governança e segurança como DMBOK, PCI DSS, NIST, CIS, ISO 27001 e ISO 27701.
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de governança de dados.
  • Perfil resolutivo, proativo e excelente capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

O que aumenta suas chances?

  • Pós-graduação ou Especialização em Cibersegurança, Segurança da Informação e Privacidade e Proteção de Dados será um diferencial.

title: Junior In-Play Trader
description:
Kaizen Gaming, the team powering Betano, is one of the biggest GameTech companies in the world, operating in 19 markets.We always aim to leverage cutting-edge technology, providing the best experience to our millions of customers who trust us for their entertainment.

We are a diverse team of more than 2.700 Kaizeners, from 40+ nationalities spreading across 3 continents. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation,or age.

Our #oneteam is proud to be among the Best Workplaces in Europe and certified Great Place to Work across our offices. Here, there’ll be no average day for you. Ready to Press Play on Potential?

Let's start with the role

This role is an opportunity to learn how the odds evolve during a game. The In-play Trading team is responsible for covering all live in-play events and plays a crucial role in shaping our customer experience.

An In-play trader manages events from a wide range of sports, including football, basketball, tennis but also general sports such as volleyball, ice-hockey, beach volleyball etc. They even offer special markets in many of them, surpassing those by other operators. This position demands concentration and observation, combined with a mathematical background, in order to ensure a seamless and enjoyable experience for our users.

The role requires a flexible working schedule to cover the busy sporting calendar (weekends, evenings etc.)

As an In Play Trader you will:

  • Monitor real - time sports events and perform live trading;
  • Supervise and adjust data with the aim of providing precise and competitive live odds;
  • Provide accurate and rapid resulting for any event of a variety of sports;
  • Use both external providers and in-house odds to optimize/customize our offerings and performance;
  • Evaluate events according to their potential demand, to offer the widest and the most competitive offer market wise;.
  • Continuously monitor bet placements, assess live events risks and take appropriate measures to manage and mitigate risks;
  • Ensure that customers have access to the most up-to-date and competitive odds, enhancing the overall betting experience;
  • Maintain effective communication within the trading team and with external stakeholders to ensure a unified and coordinated approach.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g statistics, mathematics,finance)
  • Strong interest in sports with a good understanding of various sports and betting markets;
  • Proven analytical and mathematical skills;
  • Betting/sportsbook playing experience/activity;
  • Be able to make quick, well-informed decisions and work within tight deadlines;
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills;
  • Multitasking abilities and PC literacy;
  • Fluency in English;
  • Willingness to work flexible hours in line with the business and sports calendar requirements.

Mondelez Brasil is the company's fourth-largest operation worldwide, with approximately 7,500 employees. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team at our São Paulo/SP office. As part of the Engineering department, the selected candidate will be responsible for developing highly concurrent systems in Rust, optimizing performance, distributed caching, and connection management to handle thousands of requests per second with low latency.

After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on-site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a oportunidade

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenos e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região Sudeste. Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2024 com diversas senioridades na estrutura. Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato, convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

Pré-requisitos:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;

  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • CFP ou CGA ou CFG;

Diferenciais:

Modelo de trabalho:

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Nossos valores

  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenos e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região de Campinas. Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto as áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

// Pré-requisitos:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset alllocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • CFP ou CGA ou CFG;

// Diferenciais:

  • CFA ou outras certificações.

// Modelo de trabalho:

  • Presencial em Campinas e proximidades.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass , Zenklub , VA, VR, New Value , seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

Required

description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Quality Engineer at Tractian, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the highest quality standards for our hardware products and solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including design, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to ensure that our products meet rigorous quality requirements and exceed customer expectations. Additionally, you will be responsible for identifying and collaborating with suppliers who share our commitment to excellence, further enhancing our supply chain efficiency and ensuring the consistent quality of the materials used in our products. Your expertise will contribute significantly to our mission of delivering exceptional IIoT solutions to industries worldwide.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the design and manufacturing teams to define quality standards, specifications, and inspection criteria for mechanical components and assemblies.
  • Conduct thorough quality assessments of incoming materials, ensuring they meet specified requirements and are free from defects.
  • Develop and implement quality control processes, including inspection plans, testing procedures, and relevant documentation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and corrective actions for any quality issues identified during testing or production, and track these actions to closure.
  • Participate in the design review process to provide insights on potential quality concerns and ensure design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM and DFA).
  • Conduct regular audits of manufacturing processes to identify opportunities for improvement and ensure adherence to quality standards.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to improve component quality, resolve quality-related issues, and drive continuous improvement in the supply chain.
  • Work closely with the production team to support process validation and ensure consistency in manufacturing processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of quality assurance activities, including test results, inspection reports, and non-conformance documentation.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of quality documentation, including standard operating procedures, work instructions, and quality manuals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Quality Engineer, preferably in a manufacturing or technology-driven environment.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles, materials, and manufacturing processes.
  • Familiarity in quality tools, methodologies, and documentation such as 8D, DMAIC, NCR, EA, and statistical process control.
  • Experience with inspection techniques, metrology, GD&T, and non-destructive testing methods.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to lead root cause analysis investigations.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or other quality management systems is a plus.
  • Reading and Writing English proficiency.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with microcasting and sintering.
  • Experience with plastic injection and mold manufacturing.
  • Strong understanding of Reliability Engineering and its tools.
  • Spanish proficiency.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Day off during the week of your birthday

  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.

As a Hardware Test Engineer specializing in Mechanics, your primary role will involve conducting rigorous mechanical testing and validation on a variety of hardware products.   • Analyze test results, identify mechanical failures, and collaborate with design engineers to recommend product improvements.
  • Maintain meticulous documentation of all testing procedures, results, and insights for future reference and compliance purposes.
  • Ensure all mechanical testing equipment is calibrated, maintained, and operating correctly.
  • Stay up-to-date with the mechanical testing methodologies and industry best practices.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis software like Excel.

title: Character Art Director
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a Character Art Director to join our growing team on Fortnite. This person will lead and collaborate with multidisciplinary artists to help create and maintain Epic's vision. This person will have a balance of creative thinking and a strong ability to lead a team in developing content for our various projects. By working closely with the Senior Art Director, you will be accountable for identifying and communicating a high-quality visual style, as well as developing a team of artists and coaching them to do the same.

In this role, you will

  • Be highly creative. Imagine and communicate your vision to the team to develop new content that players will love.
  • Lead Art initiatives, working closely with other non-Art Teams including Design, Engineering, Product, and Marketing.
  • Strategize with Senior Leadership to help define the Art Team's direction and priorities.
  • Create and iterate unique and stunning character designs within a determined production schedule.
  • Direct and mentor a worldwide team of artists; delivering effective feedback across all art disciplines - modeling, animation, etc.
  • Collaborate with the Product and IP teams on themes and cosmetic sets.
  • Deliver effective feedback across all art disciplines - modeling, animation, etc.

What we're looking for

  • Experience as an art director with a character design background and understanding of the 2D and 3D process in a game studio.
  • A deep understanding of the game development process and art disciplines.
  • Experience with working with Product Management on new initiatives.
  • Solid technical background in art and game development.
  • Practical experience using Unreal.
  • Strong leadership skills in order to lead a large number of people toward a singular vision.
  • Strong collaborative nature to partner with senior art directors and discipline leads.
  • Strong understanding of art fundamentals, multiple art styles, anatomy, appeal, color theory, and how color affects mood & focal points - with a focus on modern fashion-forward aesthetics.
  • Experience designing characters of a wide variety with broad appeal and the ability to adapt to and innovate new styles and techniques.
  • Experience directing and supporting artists across multiple disciplines.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, but it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Who you are:

  • Solid experience in DS/ML engineering.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Hands-on experience in implementing batch and real-time streaming pipelines, using SQL and NoSQL database solutions.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools for data pipelines, streaming systems, and model performance.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation), and MLOps platforms like MLflow.

  • Experience with Online Inference, APIs, and services that respond under tight time constraints.

As a TechOps Specialist , you’ll tackle challenging problems, monitor live production systems, and ensure smooth platform operations. Your role includes investigating incidents, escalating issues, and working with development teams to resolve problems quickly. You’ll use tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Kibana), and Octopus Deploy to monitor, troubleshoot, and manage IT operations and deployments. Additionally, you'll document processes and build a knowledge base to improve efficiency. Be ready to adapt, collaborate, and solve real-world issues in a fast-paced environment.

  • Cooperate with developer teams, providing 1st level real time production logs investigation and retrieval (ELK Stack - Kibana)
  • Perform IT operations procedures in the production environment (Octopus Deploy)
  • Perform release deployment operations in the production environment (Octopus Deploy)
  • Hands-on handling and troubleshooting of a wide variety of support matters
  • Build internal knowledge base and document articles to improve internal incident management process
  • Speedily interpret and analyze data from various sources in a fast-moving and changing environment

What you bring

  • BSc or Academy degree in Information Technology or related field
  • At lease 1-2 years of experience in a production support environment
  • Prior experience in iGaming industry will be considered an asset
  • ITIL Foundation certified or equivalent experience working in an organization adopting ITIL best practices will be a strong asset
  • Experience working in an organization adopting Incident Management and IT operations best practices will be a strong asset
  • Microsoft certifications would be considered as an asset in this area
  • Nice to have experience with monitoring tools and applications such as Grafana, Zabbix, Prometheus, PRTG, Nagios and Kibana
  • Nice to have experience with ITSM tools like Atlassian Jira, Confluence and Opsgenie
  • Willingness to work both day and night shifts in a rotation
  • Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
  • Ability to efficiently solve problems and attention to detail

Nós existimos para impactar positivamente a vida das pessoas e transformar o mundo através da tecnologia.

Nosso objetivo é que você se sinta muito mais do que apenas um número ou um resultado, pois ninguém trabalha bem sem se sentir bem. Se deseja fazer parte de um time dedicado a transformar as relações de carreira e vida pessoal, este é o lugar certo para você. Aqui, os desafios nos movem!

Na Maitha, você terá a oportunidade de atuar como Analista de QA PL, alocado em uma empresa privada brasileira de caráter público, responsável por reunir informações, fazer análises e pesquisas sobre as pessoas físicas e jurídicas que estão com dívidas financeiras.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Desenvolver e manter scripts de automação de testes para aplicativos móveis utilizando ferramentas como Appium, Selenium, ou frameworks similares.
  2. Realizar testes exploratórios e de aceite manuais em dispositivos móveis para identificar bugs, falhas de desempenho e problemas de usabilidade.
  3. Colaborar com os desenvolvedores para entender os requisitos e as funcionalidades dos produtos, garantindo que os testes atendam às especificações.
  4. Criar e manter documentação detalhada dos casos de teste, resultados e problemas identificados durante o processo de teste.
  5. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares para resolver problemas de qualidade de forma eficiente e eficaz.
  6. Participar de revisões de código e de processos para garantir a aderência às práticas de desenvolvimento de software de qualidade.

Skills necessárias:

  1. Experiência em automação de testes para aplicativos móveis, utilizando ferramentas como Appium, Selenium, ou similares.
  2. Conhecimento sólido em tipos de teste, incluindo testes funcionais, de regressão, unitários, integração e usabilidade.
  3. Conhecimento e aplicação de técnicas de teste como partição de equivalência e análise de valor limite.
  4. Capacidade de escrever scripts de automação eficientes e escaláveis em linguagens como Java, Python, ou similares.
  5. Excelente habilidade de resolução de problemas e análise crítica para identificar e relatar bugs de forma clara e precisa.
  6. Forte habilidade de comunicação e trabalho em equipe, capaz de colaborar efetivamente com desenvolvedores e outros membros da equipe.
  7. Experiência com testes de API e ferramentas como Postman e Insomnia.
  8. Vivência em ambientes ágeis de desenvolvimento, como Scrum ou Kanban.
  9. Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de teste como Zephyr, Xray, QASE e similares.
  10. Experiência na criação de pipelines de teste e estratégias de execução como Gitlab, Jenkins e similares.

O que oferecemos:

  1. Programa de pontos e premiações;
  2. Oportunidade de desenvolvimento de carreira;
  3. EDI: nossa experiência de desenvolvimento individual acompanhado por especialistas em desenvolvimento humano;

title: Property Specialist, Senior
description:
The Property Specialist, Senior

The Property Specialist, Senior will be based at one of three Amentum sites in Iraq and serve the Operations and Maintenance Support Services (OMSS) contract in support of the U.S. Department of State. This position, under general supervision, will ensure that Government property is properly identified and tracked from acquisition to disposition. This position collaborates with and reports to the Logistics Manager to schedule and resolve inventory discrepancies. The duties and responsibilities listed below are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all inclusive.

DUTIES:

  1. Responsible for maintaining a safe workplace and ensuring that safety is the highest priority in the workplace.
  2. Comply with all Environmental Health & Safety and Quality Assurance requirements and goals.
  3. Provide information and materials to these divisions as necessary to ensure adequate and legal documentation.
  4. Ensure that property records are accessible and appropriately controlled and maintained consistent with the nature of the business, property type, applicable policies and procedures, and customer requirements.
  5. Minimize administrative cost by using common processes when possible.
  6. Develop and execute plans to inventory accountable property. The frequency and method of inventory may vary based on property type and established practices.
  7. Ensure that subcontract agreements address property to be furnished to or acquired by subcontractors or other elements and include appropriate property management requirements.
  8. Assess subcontractor property control systems to provide reasonable assurance that accountable property is managed in accordance with subcontract terms and conditions.
  9. Administer and manage physical inventories of Government Property.
  10. Work closely with lower-level Property Staff and Property Custodians to ensure overall accountability of assets.
  11. Mentor lower-level Property Staff and custodians in proper process and procedures as they relate to Government Property.
  12. Identify problem areas and recommend viable solutions.
  13. Perform physical inventories of Government Furnished Property (GFP) and Contractor Acquired Property (CAP), as directed by the Logistics and Property Manager.
  14. Assign Government Property Identification numbers (GP), prepare required schedule, and assist with identifying Lost, Damaged, & Destroyed property as well as excessive consumption.
  15. Track and record movement of all types of Government property. This includes movement from one point to another within a contractor’s facility, movement between facilities, for any purpose, and protection during movement.
  16. Assist on the preparation and safeguarding of administrative support files.
  17. Prepare hand receipts for all property custodian/hand receipt holders.
  18. Ensure compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Statement of Work (SOW) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
  19. Complete routine spot checks of site assets.
  20. Maintain logs and status records to include lost, damaged, or destroyed items.
  21. Check LTDD packages for accuracy and completion.
  22. Assist with all other Logistics Warehouse duties as assigned.

REQUIRED:

  1. Minimum Acceptable Experience Level: Background in property and/or materials management.
  2. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
  3. Knowledge of the FAR and industry leading practices regarding Government Property.
  4. Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions and decimals.
  5. Collect data, define problems, and propose solutions.
  6. Understand how inventory affects company contractual obligations.
  7. Ability to clearly and concisely articulate services/requirements in writing.
  8. Ability to articulate in a clear and concise manner with Management and Trades Departments on a daily basis.
  9. Ability to lift materials and equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
  10. Ability to demonstrate analytical skills, researching skills.
  11. Ability to efficiently and effectively perform the technical requirements.
  12. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with ability to prioritize effectively and work with a sense of urgency.
  13. Ability to read, interpret and follow all Amentum /Logistic Management procedures, policies and guidelines.
  14. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions.
  15. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment that requires handling multiple tasks at a given time and rapidly adapting to changing priorities and schedules.
  16. Education: A high school diploma or GED. An undergraduate degree is preferred but can be replaced with additional years of Government Property Administration.
  17. Passport, Licenses and Certifications: As part of pre-contingency requirements, by the time the visa process starts, candidates must possess a valid passport with a minimum of 18 months remaining to expiration date with 8 blank pages. Valid drivers’ license from Home of Record.
  18. Security Vetting: Already possess a Moderate Risk Public Trust (MRPT) or be able to obtain a favorable MRPT certification prior to being hired is required for the position. Must maintain eligibility at the required certification level for the duration of the contract.
  19. Language Skills: Satisfactory English proficiency to meet job requirements and to adhere and comply with safety, health, and security measures.
  20. Medical: Successfully complete and pass the medical and dental examinations as required by Amentum and our customer for deployment to Iraq. Must maintain physical and dental requirements for duration of deployment.

DESIRED:

  1. Previous out of home country experience is highly desirable and previous work experience in harsh environmental conditions is a plus.
  2. Experience working with Amentum /PAE.

OTHER KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  1. Knowledge of ALL principles and processes involved in operating and supporting supply chain functions at a large-scale overseas facility.
  2. Experience providing excellent customer services.
  3. Cross-cultural sensitivity with an international perspective.
  4. Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  5. Expert computer skills, specifically in Microsoft Word and Excel.
  6. Ability to become an active and functioning member of a team.
  7. Must have the ability to be innovative and be an agent for change.
  8. Expert communication skills to facilitate and disseminate information.

title: Principal Research Engineer
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - SPECIAL PROJECTS What We Do

The Special Projects team at Epic is responsible for executing high-impact projects that push the envelope to define the future of real-time graphics and gaming technology (The Matrix Awakens, Lumen in the Land of Nanite). In collaboration with the Unreal Engine team, we strive to put our technology and knowledge into the hands of users, empowering developers and content creators with the most powerful suite of real-time tools in the world.

What You'll Do

The Epic Games Research & Development team is searching for an experienced hands-on Research Engineer. The ideal candidate will bring a passion for digital humans and experience with machine learning and animation tech. Epic Games creates and deploys advanced computer-vision, computer-graphics and machine learning technologies to transform the production and consumption of digital media. This includes physics based simulation, ML based character animation, neural and inverse rendering and automated generative animation techniques among others. At Epic R&D we research, develop and deploy such technologies for Epic’s Unreal Engine and other Epic Products.

In this role, you will
  • Research and prototype machine learning and generative approaches for game content creation
  • Work with development engineers and product engineers to deploy and productize novel technology results in Epic products
  • Engage with the scientific community, contribute domain knowledge and advice in support of strategically relevant R&D efforts
  • To investigate, develop novel ideas, and expand the boundaries of the state-of-the-art in research.
  • To contribute deep expertise and actionable knowledge in collaboration with other researchers and engineers at Epic Games. Tech transfer will typically involve working with Research Engineers and/or Software Engineers to provide expert technical guidance and implementation
  • To guide and mentor junior researchers and students in the internship program
What we're looking for
  • PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline
  • Proven applied research impact in shipping titles
  • Strong analytical and reasoning skills with an emphasis on innovative and practical solutions
  • Excellent programming skills with a preference for experience with Python and C++
  • Experience working in common ML frameworks such as PyTorch or Tensorflow, and rapid prototyping in Python
  • In-depth knowledge in one or more of the following areas: real-time graphics, computer vision, machine learning, animation, large-language models, speech recognition, speech synthesis, linguistics, performance-capture, 3D reconstruction
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

title: Senior Frontend Software Engineer
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Software at TRACTIAN

The software department at TRACTIAN is at the forefront of innovation, crafting an integrated ecosystem that revolutionizes maintenance and process management. Comprising a dynamic team of experts, the department develops an all-in-one software solution that seamlessly combines predictive maintenance capabilities with a comprehensive Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). This visionary approach empowers maintenance and process teams with a unified platform, enabling them to proactively predict equipment failures, optimize maintenance workflows, and enhance operational efficiency.

What you'll do

As a Senior Frontend Software Engineer, your role will focus on the development and enhancement of key features for our backend applications. You will be responsible for creating and refining features that are both user-centric and technologically advanced, contributing significantly to our product's overall functionality and user experience.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and develop a robust and scalable frontend platform, ensuring seamless integration with backend systems.
  • Lead the design and implementation of a consistent and reusable component library, improving the efficiency and maintainability of our web interfaces.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers, UI/UX designers, and product managers to ensure frontend alignment with the overall product strategy.
  • Optimize the platform for performance, ensuring fast loading times and a smooth user experience across various devices and browsers.
  • Regularly review and update the frontend architecture to keep up with emerging technologies and industry trends.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Over 5 years of experience in front-end development, with a minimum of 3 years dedicated to React.
  • Deep understanding of React principles, including but not limited to hooks, context, and component lifecycle.
  • Experience in implementing and maintaining state management solutions (Redux, Zustand, Jotai).
  • Strong knowledge in web performance optimization, responsive design, and cross-platform compatibility.
  • Experience in implementing caching strategies or asynchronous state management for high data load applications.
  • Experience in developing applications for managing complex workflows, such as ERPs.
  • Proficiency in React testing frameworks like Jest/Vitest.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in creating offline applications or desktop applications using Electron/Tauri.
  • Experience in data processing using Web Workers.
  • Familiarity with modern frontend build tools and pipelines (Vite, pnpm, Rollup, Turborepo).

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Day off during the week of your birthday
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities

This is an opportunity to run a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. We are rapidly expanding the range of open source solutions we offer and deliver to customers, as we move into new industries like telco, finance, health care and media we design and develop new open source solutions to meet their needs.
We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team's direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.
We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.
The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical
The Field Engineering team is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.
A Cloud Field Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.
Location: This role will be home based, managing a team in your time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • Experience in technical presales
  • You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Passion and a track record of developing and growing people
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience collaborating with external partners
  • Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Articulador Social- Fortaleza/CE
description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL Distribuição em São Paulo, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética, reciclagem e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia; e Iniciativa de trocar resíduos recicláveis por descontos na conta de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Articulador Social atuará na linha de frente do projeto Rede Liderança, Oficinas e Palestras comunitárias na área de concessão da Enel SP. A função interage diretamente com os parceiros envolvidos (Associações de moradores, representantes de bairro, ONGs, grupos produtivos comunitários, instituições religiosas, universidades, instituições públicas e privadas), organizando os eventos e realizando os mesmos.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Preparação e condução das reuniões de liderança com metodologia de mediação de grupos e dinâmicas;
  2. Organização e realização de Oficinas para mulheres e Palestras comunitárias;
  3. Manter um canal de comunicação próximo e direto com os parceiros, possibilitando a melhoria da qualidade dos serviços prestados pela Enel, minimizando conflitos e gerando valor compartilhado;
  4. Criar e propor estratégias de abordagem com os grupos;
  5. Realizar visitas institucionais para identificação das lideranças comunitárias;
  6. Proceder com o mapeamento e análise dos perfis das lideranças comunitárias;
  7. Prospectar líderes comunitários para fins de aplicação de questionários;
  8. Analisar e mapear os resultados e objetivos alcançados;
  9. Identificar temas levantados pelos participantes dos grupos e propor as temáticas das reuniões;
  10. Enviar relatórios periódicos de desempenho das ações do projeto;
  11. Prospectar possíveis grupos produtivos de interesse da ENEL;
  12. Participar de momentos formativos e de trabalhos propostos pela Organização;
  13. Cumprir suas atribuições conforme descrição do cargo, Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil, e Procedimentos Operacionais Internos;
  14. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade do setor.

Join to apply for the Registered Respiratory Therapist role at Lehigh Valley Health Network

Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN) is home to nearly 23,000 colleagues who make up our talented, vibrant, and diverse workforce. Join a team that delivers excellence and be part of an organization nationally recognized, forward-thinking, and offering great opportunities to do impactful work.

LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We are a Magnet™ Hospital, awarded five times by the American Nurses Credentialing Center for nursing excellence. Several of our hospitals received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, reflecting our commitment to safety, teamwork, compassion, and technology.

Summary

Administers all forms of respiratory care, both critical and general therapy, managing respiratory and pulmonary care for designated patients. Provides assessment, support, treatment, and diagnostics as part of the healthcare team.

Job Duties

  1. Evaluate, manage, and care for patients with cardiopulmonary deficiencies and abnormalities.
  2. Maintain respiratory equipment inventory and ensure adequate stock.
  3. Provide respiratory therapy as ordered by physicians, following established standards.
  4. Train staff, including physicians and students, on respiratory therapy issues.
  5. Manage mechanical ventilators, BiPAP, and monitor respiratory status.
  6. Perform emergency resuscitations, maintain airways, and measure ventilator parameters in critical care.
  7. Conduct arterial blood gas analysis and interpret pulse oximetry results.
  8. Educate patients on sleep apnea, CPAP machines, and related equipment.
  9. Set up diagnostic sleep studies.
  10. Administer respiratory medications via aerosol treatment, chart responses, and monitor progress.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate’s Degree from an accredited RRT program.
  • Less than 1 year of experience.
  • Proficiency in respiratory therapy techniques and equipment troubleshooting.
  • RRT certification (NBRC) and Pennsylvania state license within 1 year.
  • ACLS certification within 60 days.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) certification within 30 days.
  • PALS and NRP certifications within 60 days.
  • RCP licensure upon hire.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited RRT program.

Physical Demands

Ability to lift and carry 40-50 lbs, perform patient transfers, and stand/walk frequently. Activities may include kneeling, bending, squatting, and performing CPR.
